description: Create a directory if missing, with optional ACL hardening and verbose logging.
Ensure a directory exists; returns resolved path.
content:
param([string]$Path)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null }
Write-Output (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Path).Path

description: Query Windows Event Logs with basic filters (level, newest, provider).
Get recent events from a specified log; level filtering.
List running services with name, display name, and start type.
Collect OS, computer, and uptime details; outputs compact object.
content:
param([switch]$IncludeHotfixes)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
$cs=Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem
$uptime=(Get-Date)-$os.LastBootUpTime
$obj=[pscustomobject]@{ComputerName=$env:COMPUTERNAME;OS=$os.Caption;Version=$os.Version;Build=$os.BuildNumber;Manufacturer=$cs.Manufacturer;Model=$cs.Model;UptimeDays=[math]::Round($uptime.TotalDays,2)}
if($IncludeHotfixes){ $obj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName HotfixCount -NotePropertyValue (Get-HotFix | Measure-Object).Count }
$obj

description: Get processes with optional name filter and top N by CPU.
content:
param([string]$NameLike,[int]$Top)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$procs=Get-Process
if($NameLike){ $procs=$procs | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -like $NameLike } }
$procs=$procs | Sort-Object CPU -Descending
if($Top){ $procs=$procs | Select-Object -First $Top }
$procs | Select-Object ProcessName,Id,CPU,WorkingSet,StartTime -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

description: Download an MSI and install silently with logging; returns exit code.
Archive IIS logs older than N days into a zip under a target directory.
content:
param([string]$LogDir,[int]$OlderThanDays,[string]$ArchiveDir)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$cutoff=(Get-Date).AddDays(-1*$OlderThanDays)
$files=Get-ChildItem -Path $LogDir -Filter *.log -Recurse | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt $cutoff }
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ArchiveDir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ArchiveDir -Force | Out-Null }
$zip=Join-Path $ArchiveDir ("iislogs_"+(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd_HHmmss)+".zip")
Compress-Archive -Path $files.FullName -DestinationPath $zip -Force
$zip
